weaponMasteryModifier.targetSelector: Exact weaponInstanceId created by the one Gladiator weapon spin, not all definitions or discarded weapons.
weaponMasteryModifier.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
weaponMasteryModifier.formula: effectiveWeaponRankIndex = immutableRolledWeaponRankIndex + sum(distinct matching active modifiers)
weaponMasteryModifier.enchantment: At final bonus phase, effective Weapon Mastery after this scoped bonus qualifies at Master=5 or above only with active enchantable weapon/unused compatible slot. Deduplicate slot activation; existing acquisition lock still applies.
weaponMasteryModifier.cap: Configured ordered mastery scale; +2 is two rank steps, not a main-stat bonus or automatic Master.

weaponAcquisitionPolicy.blockedAcquisitionHandling: Skip a weapon-only acquisition spin before sampling, record skipped-by-gladiator with its source/continuation. Reject additional weapon creation in mixed-effect events but retain other explicitly declared effects. No replacement draw, conversion to power/stats or compensation.
weaponAcquisitionPolicy.discardHistory: Keep previous grant/result/mastery/enchant provenance in immutable journals and inactive inventory records; remove these weapons and their instance-bound effects from active loadout/final image. Do not erase independent Race stats, powers, armor or companions.
weaponAcquisitionPolicy.replay: No previous weapon is revived/regranted by replay; no second Gladiator grant. Lock persists through all later stages.

contracts.order: Actual Gladiator result/reaction -> one equal gladiator-weapon spin -> atomically ditch previous weapons, grant selected one, register +2 modifier and activate exclusive lock -> actual child reaction -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Eight authored equal outcomes at 1/8, no None, extra weapon quantity or success wheel; freeze actual eligible pool/weights before sampling.
contracts.grant: Exactly one new weapon instance. Reusing a canonical definition imports no original source event. No bundled second weapon, inherent power, stat bonus, extra weapon acquisition or body/Size grant.
contracts.discard: All earlier active owned weapons are ditched at the committed selected weapon result, even when obtained by Race events. Retain their historical records only; weapon-instance-bound modifiers/enchantments become inactive. Unrelated earlier Race rewards remain.
contracts.laterWeaponStage: Skip main Weapon acquisition and queued weapon acquisition tickets; journal their reasons without fake None/actual spins. Resolve the selected weapon normal mastery once, apply +2 after immutable raw base and the signed, unbounded score policy, resolve compatible effective-Master+ Enchant, then Power.
contracts.lock: All later weapon grants are blocked at acquisition scheduling and central inventory creation. Mixed events can apply other explicit nonweapon effects; no guessed compensation. Replay restores lock and one active selected instance.
contracts.mastery: Only the Gladiator-granted instance receives +2. No early mastery spin, guaranteed Master, extra shared Power Mastery draw or mastery effect on discarded items. Enchant modifies the same instance and grants no extra weapon.
contracts.ledger: Freeze rule version, eligible pool/weights, selected definition, prior active inventory IDs, replacement recipe and continuation. Commit discard/new grant/modifier/lock atomically once with runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourceGladiatorSpinId/eventProfileId. Media retries/replay never repeat grant/discard/modifier/spin.
contracts.reaction: Stack actual weapon, discarded inventory, +2 modifier and active restriction. Future raw mastery, Backstory and stat outcomes remain unknown; no caption-derived funny tag.
contracts.return: Actual Gladiator and its selected weapon/reaction return to Backstory. At later Weapon stage resolve only that active weapon raw mastery/optional Resilient retry, then Power; bonus +2 and compatible Enchant defer to final bonus phase. Lock blocks every additional weapon grant throughout.
contracts.bonusTiming: All authorized numeric main-stat/mastery bonuses register at their original source and calculate only in final bonus phase. Compatible Weapon Enchant uses effective mastery after bonuses there; no earlier Enchant child.
